description: This Java class defines an immutable configuration object for message mapping within the Eclipse Ditto framework, including properties, incoming and outgoing conditions, and factory methods for instantiation.

classes.name: DefaultMessageMapperConfiguration
classes.description: Immutable class implementing MessageMapperConfiguration, encapsulating message mapper settings including id, properties, and conditions.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of DefaultMessageMapperConfiguration with validation.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the message mapper configuration.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns the map of incoming message conditions.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns the map of outgoing message conditions.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on id, properties, and conditions.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on id, properties, and conditions.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the configuration object.
